cards.notes: What time is it? / It's half past three.
The museum opens at nine. / And what time does it close?
When shall we meet? / Does Saturday morning work?
Are you free tomorrow evening? / Not tomorrow, but Thursday yes.

cards.answer: Da dieci minuti, non di più.
cards.notes: How long have you been waiting? / Ten minutes, no more.
What day is it today? / Today is Tuesday.
When is your birthday? / The twelfth of March.

cards.answer: Fa bel tempo, ma un po' freddo.
cards.notes: What's the weather like? / It's nice, but a bit cold.
Is it raining tomorrow? / Yes, take an umbrella.
You're late. / Sorry, there was traffic.
How long does it take? / About half an hour by car.

cards.answer: Vado al mare con degli amici.
cards.notes: What are you doing at the weekend? / I'm going to the seaside with some friends.
